candidates.name: Rifampin-induced acute tubular necrosis
support_spans: She was started on rifampin (300 mg daily) for a planned 4-month course.
After three months of therapy, she experienced two days of nausea, vomiting, and subjective fevers.
candidates.why: The patient developed acute kidney injury after starting rifampin therapy.

candidates.name: Rifampin-induced hemolytic anemia
candidates.why: The patient developed laboratory evidence of hemolysis after starting rifampin therapy.

candidates.name: Rifampin-induced acute interstitial nephritis
support_spans: Renal ultrasound: markedly echogenic renal cortices bilaterally, consistent with parenchymal disease but no hydronephrosis
candidates.why: The patient developed kidney injury and ultrasound findings consistent with parenchymal disease after starting rifampin therapy.
